caption: The drawing depicts a square grid composed of four rows and four columns featuring repeated motifs. Each motif consists of three heart-shaped leaves in red, green, and yellow, arranged in a cluster at the center and surrounded by a circular wreath made up of alternating red, yellow, and green leaf shapes. The background color is a light beige or cream. In addition to the central motifs, there are singular heart-shaped leaves in green or yellow positioned in the corners of each square section. There is a decorative border surrounding the grid, which consists of a repeated pattern of slanted leaf shapes in red, green, and yellow. The drawing is signed "Mary Bonner" in the bottom right corner, and there is a handwritten note beneath the border that reads "8 feet by 6 feet" in pencil.
title: Quilt (Applique)
